title: Quorum Sensing Inhibitory Potential and Molecular Docking Studies of Phyllanthus emblica Phytochemicals Against Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Baburam, Sharmila; Ramasamy, Srinivasan; Shanmugam, Gnanendra; Mathanmohun, Maghimaa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物化学物对细菌群体感应蛋白的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为细菌蛋白与小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Phyllanthus emblica is a traditional medicinal plant that is endowed with curative properties including anti-bacterial, anti-fungal, anti-viral, and analgesic properties. Bacteria make use of cell-cell signaling system known as quorum sensing (QS) and respond to their own population. In most gram-negative bacteria, the transcriptional regulators belonging to the Lux R protein play a crucial role in the QS mechanism by detecting the presence of signaling molecules known as N-acyl homoserine lactones (AHLs). In this present work, the anti-quorum sensing activity of Phyllanthus emblica was evaluated against Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Anti-quorum sensing efficacy of Phyllanthus emblica was estimated with reference to QS bio-monitoring strain Chromobacterium violaceum. The binding efficacy of the phytochemicals of Phyllanthus emblica against CviR protein from Chromobacterium violaceum and LasR protein from Phyllanthus emblica were studied.
abstract_zh: Phyllanthus emblica是一种传统药用植物，具有抗菌、抗真菌、抗病毒和镇痛等治疗特性。细菌利用称为群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）的细胞间信号系统，并对其自身种群密度作出响应。在大多数革兰氏阴性细菌中，属于Lux R蛋白家族的转录调控因子通过检测称为N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯（N-acyl homoserine lactones, AHLs）的信号分子，在QS机制中发挥关键作用。本研究评估了Phyllanthus emblica对铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）的抗群体感应活性。以QS生物监测菌株紫色杆菌（Chromobacterium violaceum）为参照，评估了Phyllanthus emblica的抗群体感应功效。研究了Phyllanthus emblica中的植物化学物质对紫色杆菌CviR蛋白及Phyllanthus emblica LasR蛋白的结合效能。
